each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    I=np.array(G[n+' input']); O=np.array(G[n+' output'])
    print(n,'in',I.shape,'out',O.shape,'same shape?',I.shape==O.shape)
    # show diff positions
    diffs=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(min(I.shape[0],O.shape[0])) for c in range(min(I.shape[1],O.shape[1])) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    print('diffs:',len(diffs), diffs[:15])
    print('num equal cells:',sum(1 for _ in diffs), 'total checked:', min(I.shape[0],O.shape[0])*min(I.shape[1],O.shape[1])-len(diffs))

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(M,bg):
    M=np.array(M); H,W=M.shape; seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if M[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; cl=M[r][c]; pts=[]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    if seen[x][y]: continue
                    seen[x][y]=True; pts.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and M[nx][ny]==cl: st.append((nx,ny))
                out.append((cl,pts))
    return out
def f(I):
    cnt=Counter(I.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(I,bg)
    objs=[(col,p) for col,p in ci if len(p)>1]
    sing=[(col,p) for col,p in ci if len(p)==1]
    H,W=I.shape
    # absorption first
    O_abs=I.copy()
    for col,p in sing:
        best=None
        for oc,op in objs:
            d=min(abs(a-x)+abs(b-y) for a,b in p for x,y in op)
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,oc)
        assert best is not None
        for a,b in p: O_abs[a][b]=best[1]
    # new comps after recoloring
    ci2=comps(O_abs,bg)
    objs2=[(col,list(p)) for col,p in ci2 if len(p)>1]
    # sort objects by size descending, then iterate slides until no change
    objs2.sort(key=lambda x:-len(x[1]))
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        n=len(objs2)
        for i,(oc,p) in enumerate(objs2):
            ps=set(p)
            moved=False
            # move up
            cand=[(a-1,b) for a,b in ps]
            ok=all(0<=x<H for x,y in cand) and all(O_abs[x][y]==bg for x,y in set(cand)-set(ps))
            if ok:
                for a,b in ps: O_abs[a][b]=bg

# Fix solve to avoid numpy ambiguity: convert rows to pure lists.
def solve(I,strategy='diag'):
    I=np.array(I)
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(I,bg)
    objs=[(col,set(p)) for col,p in ci if len(p)>1]
    sing=[p for col,p in ci if len(p)==1]
    A=[[int(x) for x in row] for row in I]  # force pure list-of-lists
    for p in sing:
        (a,b)=list(p)[0]
        def md(o,m): return min(abs(ar-x)+abs(br-y) for ar,br in o for x,y in [m])
        best=min(range(len(objs)),key=lambda i:md(objs[i][1],(a,b)))
        for q in p: A[q[0]][q[1]]=objs[best][0]
    def ncomps(M,bg):
        H_,W_=len(M),len(M[0]); seen_=[[False]*W_ for _ in range(H_)]; res=[]
        for r in range(H_):
            for c in range(W_):
                if M[r][c]!=bg and not seen_[r][c]:
                    st=[(r,c)]; pts=[]
                    while st:
                        x,y=st.pop()
                        if seen_[x][y]: continue
                        seen_[x][y]=True; pts.append((x,y))
                        for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                            if 0<=nx<H_ and 0<=ny<W_ and not seen_[nx][ny] and M[nx][ny]==M[r][c]: st.append((nx,ny))
                    res.append(pts)
        return res
    com=ncomps(A,bg)
    objs2=[]
    for p in com:
        if len(p)>1: objs2.append((A[list(p)[0][0]],set(p)))
    objs2.sort(key=lambda x:-len(x[1]))
    H_,W_=len(A),len(A[0])
    if strategy=='diag':
        for oc,p in objs2:
            cur=list(p)
            while True:
                cand=[(a-1,b-1) for a,b in cur]
                if any(a<0 or b<0 for a,b in cand): break
                ok=all(A[a][b]==bg for a,b in cand)
                if not ok: break
                nb=[row[:] for row in A]
                for a,b in cur: nb[a][b]=bg
                for a,b in cand: nb[a][b]=oc
                A=nb
                cur=cand
    elif strategy=='leftthenup':
        for oc,p in objs2:
            p2=list(p)
            while True:
                up=[(a-1,b) for a,b in p2]
                ok=all(0<=a<H_ and 0<=b<W_ and A[a][b]==bg for a,b in up)
                if ok:
                    nb=[row[:] for row in A]
                    for a,b in p2: nb[a][b]=bg
                    for a,b in up: nb[a][b]=oc
                    A=nb; p2=up
                else:
                    left=[(a,b-1) for a,b in p2]
                    ok2=all(0<=a<H_ and 0<=b<W_ and A[a][b]==bg for a,b in left)
                    if ok2:
                        nb=[row[:] for row in A]
                        for a,b in p2: nb[a][b]=bg
                        for a,b in left: nb[a][b]=oc
                        A=nb; p2=left
                    else: break
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(A) if any(x!=bg for x in row)]
    cs=[c for row in A for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
    out=[]
    if rs and cs:
        for row in A[rs[0]:rs[-1]+1]:
            out.append([row[c] for c in range(cs[0],cs[-1]+1)])
    return out

import numpy as np, scipy.ndimage as ndi, itertools
def comps(A,bg):
    A=np.array(A); L=A!=bg
    lab,n=ndi.label(L,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==i)
        out.append(sorted(zip(rs.tolist(),cs.tolist())))
    return out
def norm(cs):
    mr=min(r for r,c in cs); mc=min(c for r,c in cs)
    return [(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cs]
# demo5: recolor 9->main color per component, then greedy connect
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 5 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 5 output'])
c=[cs for cs in comps(I,8)]
objs=[]
for i,cs in enumerate(c):
    cc=[I[r][q] for r,q in cs]
    main=max(set(cc), key=lambda x: sum(1 for y in cc if y==x))
    recolor=True if sum(1 for x in cc if x!=main)==1 else None
    objs.append({'id':i,'cells':[(r,q) for r,q in cs],'main':main,'norm':norm([(r-min(r for r,c2 in cs),q-min(q for r,c2 in cs)) for r,q in cs])})
print(objs)

import os,re,numpy as np,scipy.ndimage as ndi
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(A,bg):
    A=np.array(A); L=A!=bg; lab,n=ndi.label(L,structure=np.ones((3,3))); out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1): rs,cs=np.where(lab==i); out.append(sorted(zip(rs.tolist(),cs.tolist())))
    return out
def norm(cells):
    mr=min(r for r,q in cells); mc=min(q for r,q in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((r-mr,q-mc) for r,q in cells))
I7=np.array(G['Demo pair 7 input']); O7=np.array(G['Demo pair 7 output'])
H,W=len(I7),len(I7[0])
nz=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O7[r][c]!=5)
cs=comps(I7,5)
sizes=[len(c) for c in cs]; print('comp sizes',sizes)
# find placements: piece recolored to dominant color placed at translation whose shape inside nz
pieces=[]
for c in cs:
    cnt=Counter(int(I7[a][b]) for a,b in c); dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    N=norm([(a,b) for a,b in c])
    pieces.append({'dom':dom,'cells':N})
# For each piece, enumerate placements with pt<=nz; then search exact cover by recursion
T=[]
for p in pieces:
    pts=[set((dr+a,dc+b) for a,b in p['cells']) for dr in range(-H,H+1) for dc in range(-W,W+1) if set((dr+a,dc+b) for a,b in p['cells'])<=nz]
    T.append(pts)
def solve(idx,covered):
    if idx==len(pieces): return covered==nz
    for pt in T[idx]:
        sub=covered|pt
        if sub<=nz:
            res=solve(idx+1,sub)
            if res: return res
    return None
res=solve(0,set())
print('exact cover exists:',res is not None)

import os,glob,re,numpy as np,scipy.ndimage as ndi
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['5','6','7','8']:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bgc=int(np.bincount(I.flatten()).argmax())
    lab,n=ndi.label(I!=bgc,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    cs=[np.argwhere(lab==i).tolist() for i in range(1,n+1)]
    nz=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if O[r][c]!=bgc)
    T=[]
    for p in cs:
        cnt=Counter(int(I[a,b]) for a,b in p); dom=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        mr=min(a for a,b in p); mc=min(b for a,b in p)
        N=[(a-mr,b-mc) for a,b in p]
        pts=[set((dr+a,dc+b) for a,b in N) for dr in range(-H,H+1) for dc in range(-W,W+1) if set((dr+a,dc+b) for a,b in N)<=nz]
        T.append(pts)
    def dfs(idx,covered,path):
        if covered==nz: return path[:]
        if idx==len(cs): return None
        for pt in T[idx]:
            sub=covered|pt
            if sub<=nz:
                res=dfs(idx+1,sub,path+[('col',{k:int(I[a][b]) for k,(a,b) in enumerate(p)},idx,pt)])
                if res is not None: return res
        return None
    result=None
    try:
        colmaps=[{k:int(I[a][b]) for k,(a,b) in enumerate(p)} for k,p in enumerate(cs)]
        def dfs2(idx,covered,path):
            if covered==nz: return path[:]
            if idx==len(cs): return None
            for pt in T[idx]:
                sub=covered|pt
                if sub<=nz:
                    res=dfs2(idx+1,sub,path+[('col',colmaps[idx],idx,pt)])
                    if res is not None: return res
            return None
        result=dfs2(0,set())
    except Exception as e:
        print('exc',e)
    pred=None; ok=False
    if result:
        pred=np.full((H,W),bgc,dtype=int)
        for typ,cm,idx,pt in result:
            for cell,color in cm.items(): pred[cell]=color
        ok=all(pred[r][c]==O[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W))
        print(f'pair{n}: preserve-color exact={ok}')
